TCD.note: The document states no authentication service.
The document states no link between the civil register and the ID system.
The document names no identity law.
Only enrolment targets are stated, no count or share of the population holding an ID.
The document says nothing about numbers at birth.
The document does not say who operates, maintains or owns the system.
The document names no public register keyed on the ID number.

systems.system: base de donnees nationale / Numero National d'Identification (NNI)

TCD.note: The document names the national database and NNI but does not state that it issues unique credentials, checks biometrics for duplicates, or is certified.
The document is not about police stations.

facts.fact: UNHCR, with ANATS and CNARR, launched at the Abeche one-stop desk on 21 November 2025 an EU-funded biometric enrolment of Sudanese refugees into the national database to assign adult refugees a National Identification Number (NNI), targeting 15,000 by end-2025 and 50,000 by the end of the PADERCA project.
